title: Ada and the Horizon
author: Oscar Ashgrove
blurb: Bram Blackwood, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
